_note: Landing page for each post theme. The daily-post and YouTube Short scheduled tasks pick the link from here. To send people to a more specific page, replace the URL for that theme (keep the full https:// address). 'pages' can hold extra topic pages (e.g. a blog article) keyed by a short topic name; a task uses a 'pages' entry when today's topic clearly matches it, otherwise the theme link. NOTE 2026-11-05: GitHub Pages is not enabled on the repo (has_pages=false), so github.io links return errors; themes now point to the website blog page until Pages is turned on.
